title: Raw DXF object-list callback capture bounds
mode: Local adapter implementation with generated focused validation
scope: Charge two logical list-link pointer slots for bounded raw DXF object callbacks stored in std::list.
Use a shared estimator for raw object list-backed retention and preserve vector-backed raw estimates.
Update expected logical-retention totals and add exact-byte cross-family generated controls.
Keep the fast strict-target plus owning CTest validation cadence.

changes.implementation: estimateRawDxfObjectListNodeBytes adds two logical pointer slots to the bounded raw-object estimate. It is used for VISUALSTYLE, DICTIONARYWDFLT/PLACEHOLDER, MATERIAL, DETAILVIEWSTYLE/SECTIONVIEWSTYLE, RENDERSETTINGS/background/SUN, SORTENTSTABLE/TABLESTYLE, FIELD/FIELDLIST, named-resource, and raw ACAD_PROXY_OBJECT list stores. Vector-backed raw associative/spatial-filter stores and raw sections remain unchanged. Raw proxy had already been charged two slots and now uses the common helper without changing its estimate.
changes.generatedControl: One generated selector sends empty-group raw records through each list-backed callback family and asserts the exact sizeof(DRW_RawDxfObject) + name bytes + two pointer links total. Existing owner tests were updated for the same logical charge while preserving their limit and fail-closed checks.
changes.limitations: The two pointer slots are logical bounded-retention accounting, not allocator-specific node overhead or process RSS. This does not qualify raw-carrier serialization or external semantics.

limitationsAndNext: The raw list-backed adapter estimate gap is closed for the enumerated callback routes. Continue the remaining 7S.2c list/vector owner census and do not equate logical accounting with RSS, complete preservation, or semantic support. The shared worktree remains user-owned and uncommitted; Git metadata is read-only.
